rules.description: RULES.md plus every skill's name and description stay under 1,000 tokens (zero points at 5,000).
rules.fix: Shorten RULES.md and the skill descriptions, or move detail into a skill body that loads on demand.

rules.description: The longest skill body stays within 500 lines (zero points at 1,000).
rules.fix: Split the skill, or move reference material into a linked file that loads on demand.

rules.description: No skill body exceeds 5,000 tokens.
rules.fix: Move the bulk of the skill into on-demand reference files and keep SKILL.md short.

rules.description: No paragraph repeats across skills.
rules.fix: Keep the paragraph in one skill and link to it from the others.

rules.description: Each skill name is lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 64 characters, with no reserved word.
rules.fix: Rename the skill in its frontmatter.

rules.description: Each skill has a non-empty description of at most 1,024 characters.
rules.fix: Add or shorten the description in the skill's frontmatter.

rules.description: Each description is written in the third person.
rules.fix: Rewrite the description without I, you or we.

rules.description: Each description says what the skill does and when to use it.
rules.fix: Say what the skill does, then when to use it ("Use when ...").

rules.description: Each skill can be reached without being named: a trigger clause, a forced load, or the pack's relevanceDetector.
rules.fix: Add a "Use when ..." clause to the description, or force-load the skill.

rules.description: Reference files linked from a skill do not link onward to more files.
rules.fix: Link every reference file directly from SKILL.md instead of from another reference file.

rules.description: A reference file over 100 lines opens with a table of contents.
rules.fix: Add a Contents section near the top of the reference file.

rules.description: Skills use forward-slash paths only.
rules.fix: Replace backslash paths with forward slashes.

rules.description: Skills carry no wording that expires on a date.
rules.fix: Remove the dated wording, or state the rule without a date.

rules.description: A script a skill names is in the pack, executable where it is a shell or Python script, and reached by a relative path.
rules.fix: Ship the script in the pack, mark it executable and refer to it by a relative path.

rules.description: The share of checks that are declared rather than coded; a pack with no checks scores half.
rules.fix: Express the check as an entry in declared-checks.json instead of coded Go.

rules.description: The linked public repository's tree matches the pack path, verified by the registry.
rules.fix: Publish with trusted publishing from the repository that holds the pack at its declared path.

rules.description: The version is bound to a commit.
rules.fix: Publish from a GitHub Actions run so the version records its commit.

rules.description: The version was published by trusted publishing.
rules.fix: Use the claudinite/publish-pack action instead of a web upload.

rules.description: A guard costs 3 points.
rules.fix: Drop the guard, or accept the cost.

rules.description: Coded checks cost 3 points.
rules.fix: Declare the checks in declared-checks.json instead of coding them.

rules.description: A task costs 1 point, 2 more if it opens pull requests and 2 more if it has an agentic phase.
rules.fix: Drop the task, or remove its pull-request and agentic steps.

rules.description: Environment setup costs 2 points.
rules.fix: Drop the environment setup.

rules.description: Each declared GitHub action costs 1 point, up to 3.
rules.fix: Drop the GitHub actions the pack does not need.
